response.rationale: R5 uniquely matches the pathognomonic combination of rippled skin and deep dermal mucin, which are highly specific for scleromyxedema. Other candidates lack these decisive features and rely on less specific findings like granulomatous inflammation or histiocytes.

rejected.why: Lacks mucin and rippled skin; purpuric infarcts are nonspecific.
Has granulomatous inflammation and histiocytes but no mucin or rippled skin; less specific.
Granulomatous inflammation and histiocytes without mucin or rippled skin; not characteristic.
